[RFCS.17.5] On replay a reader **must** treat each atom by its stream-class: deliver
an `inject` atom to the engine as a recorded input; **re-derive** a `compare` atom and
byte-compare it to the record and **must not** deliver it ([LFST.9.3]); and treat a
`structural` atom as framing/schema/seek with no replay-input role.
